objective: Report the count of catalogue products whose product kind is "Nut Bolt and Washer".

params.target_kind_name: literal product kind name 'Nut Bolt and Washer'
params.kind_id: lookup product_kinds.product_kind_id WHERE product_kind_name = 'Nut Bolt and Washer'
params.product_count: count rows in product_variants WHERE product_kind_id = (SELECT product_kind_id FROM product_kinds WHERE product_kind_name = 'Nut Bolt and Washer')

constraints.rule: When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
see sql tool that takes SQLite query as stdin. It operates with the state of the entire catalogue at the start of the session.
